enquiry: We handle a petroleum stream and currently send samples to a laboratory for water determination. We want to investigate a fiber based measurement closer to the process so that changes can be noticed sooner. The analyzer would be outside the process area. Before selecting equipment, we need to know what to clarify and what a first comparison experiment should establish.

recommendations.rationale: A supplied example measures water content in petroleum with ATR probes, and strong mid-IR water absorption keeps the ATR path very short. Nominal mid-IR range is 4000-400 cm-1; the usable range depends on the instrument, fiber and probe chosen.
recommendations.conditions: Applies if the stream is a liquid or soft solid that can wet the ATR crystal and if a mid-IR fiber link of the needed length to the remote analyzer can be provided.

citations.quote: Application: measurement of water content in petroleum

recommendations.rationale: NIR is the most common online method with fiber probes and silica fibers are stated to allow long cable runs, which fits an analyzer placed outside the process area. The usable range depends on the instrument, fiber and probe chosen.
recommendations.conditions: Applies if the stream is a clear or semi-transparent liquid that allows a defined transmission pathlength.

citations.quote: Near-IR vibrational spectroscopy (NIR) is the most common online analysis method performed using fiber optic probes.

assessment.chemometrics_note: Both mid-IR and NIR water determination work through a calibration model rather than a single peak; NIR bands overlap and need chemometrics, and a calibration is specific to the sample matrix, so it must be re-validated when the stream or its composition changes.
assessment.realtime_tracking_note: The point of moving closer to the process is that fiber probes give results in near real time instead of a laboratory turnaround. The achievable time resolution depends on the method, probe and spectrometer actually chosen and is not stated in the sources.

proposal.what_would_change_it: If the stream turns out clear and the analyzer must sit far from the process, NIR transmission would move to the front. If the needed mid-IR fiber link cannot be provided, the mid-IR ATR option would drop out of the shortlist.
proposal.next_step: Run the comparison experiment on representative samples against the current laboratory water determination, with the go/no-go criteria agreed before the trial.

assessment.brief_answer: Test mid-infrared ATR spectroscopy first: a supplied example measures water content in petroleum with ATR probes. In the same laboratory trial, compare it with a near-infrared geometry chosen by the stream's optical behaviour, using your current laboratory water determination as the reference. What is still open: the water range and accuracy you need, whether the stream is clear or turbid, and whether a fiber link to a remote analyzer is long enough for mid-infrared.
